description: Get recent news articles about a company within a date range. Returns headline, summary, source, and URL. Example: get_company_news({ symbol: "AAPL", from: "2024-01-01", to: "2024-01-31", _apiKey: "your-key" })

from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-31"

name: get_company_news
